hook: Molybdenum clusters glow with circularly polarized light, and a spin-forbidden transition is seen by MCD.
hook_turn: and a spin-forbidden transition is seen by MCD.
summary: Three Mo6I8 cluster compounds were measured with magnetic circular dichroism and magnetic circularly polarized luminescence. The authors report the first direct MCD observation of a spin-forbidden singlet-to-triplet transition in a metal cluster, and strong phosphorescent polarization. Calculations were done on a chlorine model cluster, and the triplet signal needed highly concentrated solutions.
title: Magneto-Optical Studies on the Orbital Angular Momenta and Spin–Orbit Coupling in the Excited Triplet States of Octahedral Mo6 Clusters: Magnetic Circular Dichroism and Magnetic Circularly Polarized Luminescence
venue: Journal of the American Chemical Society
